payload.task: Perform the first relay round-trip acknowledgement on the development branch only. Persist Builder evidence, then hand off to Verifier without touching main or production.
acceptance: Builder reads current mission and packet from cloud-relay-v2.
Builder creates one minimal evidence record under missions/CLOUD-RELAY-V2/state/EVIDENCE/.
Builder does not merge, deploy, handle secrets, expand permissions, modify governance/personality, or perform destructive actions.
Builder hands off exactly one unconsumed packet to VERIFIER with evidence reference.
payload.rollback: Restore MISSION_STATE.json and RELAY_PACKET.json to the pre-dispatch SHAs recorded by Coordinator.
